paragraphs.source_en: Just as a mirror is an instrument for brewing self-conceit, it is at the same time an instrument for disinfecting vanity. If one faces it with thoughts of gaudy vanity, there is no tool better suited to inciting fools. Since ancient times, perhaps two-thirds of all cases of arrogant people harming themselves and others have surely been the work of mirrors. Just as, during the French Revolution, a novelty-loving doctor sinned by inventing the guillotine, the first person who made a mirror must surely have suffered pangs of conscience afterward. Yet when one has begun to be sick of oneself, or when the ego has shriveled, nothing is more medicinal than looking in a mirror. For beauty and ugliness are made perfectly plain. One is bound to realize how extraordinary it is that, with a face like this, one has managed to live until today, and even to strut before others claiming to be a human being. The moment one realizes that is the most blessed season in a human life. Nothing in the world seems more precious than knowing oneself to be a fool. Before such a self-aware fool, every swaggering pretender ought to bow his head and yield. Even if some fellow thinks he is proudly despising and mocking me, from my side his very haughtiness amounts to lowering his head in submission. Of course, the master is not so wise a man as to look in the mirror and perceive his own folly, but he is still a man capable of reading fairly the pockmarks inscribed on his face. To acknowledge the ugliness of one's face may become a step toward comprehending the baseness of one's heart. The master is really quite a promising fellow. This too may be the result of having been thoroughly put in his place by the philosopher.

paragraphs.source_en: Thinking thus, I went on observing the master's condition. The unsuspecting master, after making faces by turning down his eyelid, said, "It seems quite bloodshot. It must be chronic conjunctivitis after all." With that, he rubbed his congested eyelid hard several times with his index finger. It was probably itching, but when it was already so red without rubbing, how could it endure this? Before long it is certain to rot into a hollow like the eyeball of a salted sea bream. Presently the master opened his eyes again and turned to the mirror. When I looked, sure enough, as expected, those lifeless eyes were clouded and dull like the winter sky of the northern provinces. To be sure, even ordinarily his eyes are not especially bright. To put it with an exaggerated adjective, they are so murky and vague that one can hardly distinguish the black of the eye from the white. Just as his mind is always hazy and consistently impossible to grasp, so his gaze too is dim and obscure, forever drifting in the depths of his sockets. Some say this is due to congenital poison, while others explain it as an aftereffect of smallpox. It is said that in his childhood he was made to take, as folk remedies, quite a few willow caterpillars and red frogs. Yet for all the devoted efforts of his loving mother, there was no reward; to this day he remains as blank and befuddled as when he was born. Privately, I think this condition is by no means due to congenital poison or smallpox. The reason his eyes wander in this sad state of obscurity and muddiness is simply that his brain is made of a substance neither transparent nor clear, and because its workings have reached the utmost degree of gloom and mist, this naturally appears in bodily form, causing needless worry to a mother who did not know the true cause. Where smoke rises, one knows there must be fire; where the eyes are cloudy, that merely proves stupidity. Seen this way, his eyes are the symbol of his heart; and since his heart has a hole in it like a Tenpo coin, his eyes too, like a Tenpo coin, must be large in size yet of no practical currency.

paragraphs.source_zh: 我一边这样想着，一边在继续观察着主人的情况。毫无觉察的主人，在玩完了“翻眼皮”之后，说道：“好像充血呢，肯定是慢性结膜炎了。”说罢，他用食指狠狠地揉了几下充血的眼睑。很可能是发痒吧，不过，不揉已经是那样红了，现在经这么一揉，如何受得了，肯定在不远的将来，会和盐渍鲷鱼的眼珠一样，烂成个窟窿的。主人很快又张开眼睛去照镜子。我一看，果然不出所料，那无神的眼睛活像北国冬天的天空，黯淡无光。当然，就是在平时，他的眼睛也不是那么炯炯有神的。如果可以夸大形容的话，那是一种无法分清黑眼珠与白眼珠的混浊的眼睛。正像他的精神状态总是一贯朦朦胧胧，不得要领一样，他的眼神也是暧昧得很，永远在眼窝中飘浮着。有的说这是胎毒所致，有的则解释为痘疮的后遗症。据说他在小时候，也没少吃过作为偏方的柳树上的毛虫和山蛤蟆。可是爱子心切的母亲虽然想尽了办法，但他今天还是和生下来的当时一样，头脑糊里糊涂的。按我的想法，这决不是因为胎毒或出天花的缘故。他的眼神之所以这样彷徨于晦涩溷浊的悲境之中，完全是因为他的头脑实际上是不透不明而形成的，其作用达于暗淡溟濛之极，所以才自然表现在形体上，结果让不了解这一情况的母亲为他操了许多心。烟升起处证明必定有火，眼神混浊，则正证明其愚钝而已。这样看来，他的眼神是他心的象征，他的心像天宝铜钱那样中间有孔，所以他的眼睛也和天宝铜钱一样，尽管个儿大，却不通用。
